_instructions: Document your ideal client personas here. Use these to guide marketing, sales, product development, and content strategy.

demographics._instructions: Who they are: age, industry, role, company size, location, income.
demographics.location: Greenville, SC and Greenville County, plus nearby towns within about 25 miles. Tier 1: Simpsonville, Taylors, Easley, Greer. Tier 2: Mauldin, Fountain Inn, Travelers Rest, Five Forks, Powdersville, Berea, Wade Hampton. Tier 3: Piedmont, Pickens, Woodruff. Also served: Parker, Gantt, Sans Souci, Welcome, Judson, Dunean, City View, Golden Grove, Lyman, Duncan, Wellford, Liberty, Central, Williamston, Pelzer, Slater-Marietta, Tigerville, Landrum, Gray Court (source: knowledge/research/playbook.md).
demographics.income_or_revenue_level: Middle to upper-middle income, owns a home with mature trees.

psychographics_and_mindset._instructions: How they think: values, beliefs, mindset, aspirations, fears, vision.
core_values: Not being talked into unnecessary jobs
psychographics_and_mindset.mindset_or_philosophy: Trees are an asset until they become a risk, and they would rather pay to handle it now than pay for damage later.
aspirations: Having one reliable company to call
fears_and_anxieties: A tree falling on the house in a storm
A crew that leaves a mess
psychographics_and_mindset.ideal_future_state: A yard where the trees are healthy, the house is safe, and I don't have to think about it.

problems_and_pain_points._instructions: What's keeping them up at night.
top_pain_points: A tree leaning toward the house
A mess left in the yard

cost_of_problem.time: Days spent waiting for a quote, and time spent finding a company they can trust.
cost_of_problem.money: Damage to a fence or roof, the price of an emergency call, and cost surprises.
cost_of_problem.opportunity: A yard that is unusable or unsafe while the tree is still a hazard.
cost_of_problem.morale: Stress whenever a storm is forecast.

previous_solutions_attempted: Handling it themselves with a saw or ladder
Getting quotes from other tree companies
problems_and_pain_points.why_previous_solutions_failed: A saw or ladder is unsafe for a tall tree, a neighbor or handyman lacked the equipment or insurance, and other quotes were too high, too vague, or never came back.

goals_and_desired_outcomes.primary_goal: Getting the tree safely removed or trimmed, keeping the house undamaged, and finishing the job without a headache.

metrics: The tree is gone or trimmed
feelings: They felt safe during the work

secondary_goals: Keeping the yard usable for their family
Having one company to call for later trimming
goals_and_desired_outcomes.timeline: This week for urgent problem trees, and within a month for routine trimming.

budget_and_decision_making.budget_range: Market benchmark (source not specified; not a confirmed customer budget). Trimming: small (under 25 ft) $75-$450, medium (25-50 ft) $150-$600, large (50-75 ft) $300-$1,000, very large (75+ ft) $700-$2,000+. Cutting down/removal: small $150-$500, medium $450-$1,200, large $800-$1,500, very large $1,000-$2,500+.
budget_and_decision_making.decision_making_process: They search online, read reviews, get two or three quotes, compare price and trust, then choose.
budget_and_decision_making.sales_cycle_length: Same day for emergencies, and one to two weeks for routine trims while they collect quotes.

content_and_communication_preferences._instructions: How they like to learn and where they hang out.
discovery_methods: A Google search when a problem comes up
A yard sign or truck they've seen

objections_and_hesitations._instructions: What might stop them from buying.
common_objections: Not trusting a company they've never heard of
Doubting that a quick job will be done safely
solution_disqualifiers: Pressure to decide on the spot
A crew that leaves a mess
change_concerns: Switching from a company they've used before
Trusting a new crew with a big tree near the house
Paying upfront before the work is done

buying_signals_and_readiness._instructions: When they're ready and what wins them over.
buying_signals: A tree has already dropped a limb or cracked a fence
deal_breakers: Pressure to decide on the spot
A crew that leaves a mess

demographics._instructions: Who they are: age, industry, role, company size, location, income.
demographics.company_size: Solo, startup, SMB, and enterprise (all sizes)
demographics.location: Greenville, SC and Greenville County, plus nearby towns within about 25 miles. Tier 1: Simpsonville, Taylors, Easley, Greer. Tier 2: Mauldin, Fountain Inn, Travelers Rest, Five Forks, Powdersville, Berea, Wade Hampton. Tier 3: Piedmont, Pickens, Woodruff. Also served: Parker, Gantt, Sans Souci, Welcome, Judson, Dunean, City View, Golden Grove, Lyman, Duncan, Wellford, Liberty, Central, Williamston, Pelzer, Slater-Marietta, Tigerville, Landrum, Gray Court (source: knowledge/research/playbook.md).

psychographics_and_mindset._instructions: How they think: values, beliefs, mindset, aspirations, fears, vision.
core_values: No disruption to tenants or customers
psychographics_and_mindset.mindset_or_philosophy: Tree work is a maintenance cost that prevents bigger liability, and they want it handled quickly by someone they can trust to show up.
aspirations: Keeping the property safe and attractive
Having one vendor to call for every property
fears_and_anxieties: A tree or limb injuring someone on the property
A vendor who doesn't show up
Work that disrupts tenants or customers
psychographics_and_mindset.ideal_future_state: A portfolio where the trees are safe, the claims are zero, and I don't get calls about the yard.

problems_and_pain_points._instructions: What's keeping them up at night.
top_pain_points: Trees near buildings or parking areas
Finding a vendor who responds quickly

cost_of_problem.time: Time lost chasing vendors and comparing inconsistent quotes.
cost_of_problem.money: Damage and claims from trees near buildings or parking areas, plus storm cleanup across multiple properties.
cost_of_problem.opportunity: Tenants or customers frustrated by an unsafe or disrupted lot.
cost_of_problem.morale: Stress after a storm and ongoing worry about liability.

previous_solutions_attempted: Using a landscaper or maintenance crew for tree work
problems_and_pain_points.why_previous_solutions_failed: Landscapers lacked the equipment or insurance for large trees, the cheapest vendor didn't show up or did poor work, and collecting quotes for every property took too long with prices all over the place.

goals_and_desired_outcomes.primary_goal: Keeping every property safe and claim-free while getting reliable vendors who show up.

metrics: Vendors arrive on the scheduled day
results: Tenants or customers never notice the work

goals_and_desired_outcomes.timeline: This week for urgent hazards or storm damage, and within a month for routine maintenance.

budget_and_decision_making.budget_range: Market benchmark, raised 20% over the Homeowner benchmark (source not specified; not a confirmed customer budget). Trimming: small (under 25 ft) $90-$540, medium (25-50 ft) $180-$720, large (50-75 ft) $360-$1,200, very large (75+ ft) $840-$2,400+. Cutting down/removal: small $180-$600, medium $540-$1,440, large $960-$1,800, very large $1,200-$3,000+.
decision_makers_involved: A property manager who handles vendors
budget_and_decision_making.decision_making_process: They search online or ask other managers, get multiple quotes, check insurance and references, then choose one vendor to use for all properties.
budget_and_decision_making.sales_cycle_length: Same day for emergencies or storm damage, and one to four weeks for routine work.

content_and_communication_preferences._instructions: How they like to learn and where they hang out.
preferred_content_formats: Written quote with scope and insurance details
publications_blogs_and_influencers: CO by U.S. Chamber of Commerce (https://www.uschamber.com/co)
discovery_methods: A recommendation from another property manager
A vendor already used at another property
A truck or sign they've seen

Doubting a vendor will do the work without disrupting tenants or customers
change_concerns: Switching from a vendor they already use
